description: Source code for the 'descriptor' package providing functions for handling Protocol Buffers descriptors, including extraction, message handling, and scalar field identification.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: Interface representing a Protocol Buffers message with a method to return its descriptor.

classes.name: FieldDescriptorProto
classes.description: Proto message type for field descriptors, with method to check if a field is scalar.

methods.name: extractFile
methods.description: Extracts a FileDescriptorProto from a gzip compressed byte slice.

methods.name: ForMessage
methods.description: Returns the FileDescriptorProto and DescriptorProto for a given message.

methods.name: IsScalar
methods.description: Determines if a FieldDescriptorProto represents a scalar numeric type.
